description_zh: 通过本接口，可以查询预测式外呼通话记录信息
name: CloudQueryPredictiveCallCdr

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the outbound call task
parameters.help_zh: 外呼任务id
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the batch
parameters.help_zh: 批次id
parameters.name: task_file_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the phone call. If this parameter is specified, other parameters are ignored and only the record with this unique identifier is queried
parameters.help_zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the request. By default, records of the current month are queried. If the request unique ID does not belong to the current month, pass the pass-through query parameter startTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询请求唯一id对应的记录信息，默认查询当前月，如requestUniqueId不属于当前月，查询时请传递查询参数 查询开始时间(startTime)
parameters.name: request_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The customer phone number. Example: 18012345678
parameters.name: customer_number

parameters.help_en: The agent ID, which must be 3 to 10 digits in length
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号，3-10位数字
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The outbound call group to which the agent belongs. A single group ID must be 2 to 20 characters in length. You can specify one or more agent IDs separated by commas. A maximum of 10 agent IDs can be specified at a time. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属外呼组 单个外呼组号2-20位，支持一个或多个座席工号查询，多个座席工号以英文逗号隔开，一次最多支持10个。不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: gno

parameters.help_en: The displayed caller ID number
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码；外显的号码
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The actual caller ID number displayed to the customer. When the AXB scenario is used for outbound calls, the actual caller ID number displayed to the customer is a service instance
parameters.help_zh: 客户侧真实外显号码，当使用AXB场景进行外呼时，客户侧的真实外显号码为服务实例
parameters.name: display_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call is downgraded. Valid values: 0 (no) and 1 (yes)
parameters.help_zh: 是否呼叫降级；0-否, 1-是
parameters.name: down_grade

parameters.help_en: The call result parameter. The metric description is as follows: 40 (predictive outbound call, customer did not answer), 41 (predictive outbound call, customer answered), 42 (predictive outbound call, called), and 43 (predictive outbound call, both parties answered)
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明：40:预测外呼, 客户未接听； 41:预测外呼, 客户接听； 42: 预测外呼,已呼叫； 43: 预测外呼, 双方接听
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The province to which the customer phone number belongs. If this parameter is empty, all provinces are queried. Example: Sichuan. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city to which the customer phone number belongs. If this parameter is empty, all cities are queried. Example: Chengdu. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The effective type of the start and end time range for the query. This parameter takes effect when startTime and endTime are specified. Valid values: 1 (call start time) and 2 (call end time). Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. The time range specified by startTime and endTime cannot cross months. Default value: the first day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value must be a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. The time range specified by startTime and endTime cannot cross months. Default value: the last day of the current month
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The starting entry number for the query. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The key of the custom user parameter for the query. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify UserFieldValue. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The constructed custom field-specific search condition is {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_fieldkey

parameters.help_en: The value of the custom user parameter for the query. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify UserFieldkey. Only one field can be queried, and fuzzy match is not supported. The constructed custom field-specific search condition is {"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}. This parameter must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配，构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
parameters.name: user_field_value

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the call is answered by a real person. Valid values: 1 (yes) and 0 (no)
parameters.help_zh: 真人接听；取值说明：1-是、0-否
parameters.name: is_real_answer
